name: Stock Market 2
description: A daily-round single-symbol exchange simulation with a real order book (bid/ask spread, market and limit orders, partial fills, GTC/DAY lifetimes, synthetic external liquidity, player-vs-player matching). Runs in SYNTHETIC mode (a seeded placeholder price process, the default) or HISTORICAL mode (replaying the real Denny's Corp / DENN daily record with real SEC-filing-derived news events). Plays solo (one bot vs. the market) or head-to-head with multiple bots.
